name: The simple short corner
tactical_objective: Use a short corner to pull the defender who protects the space near the corner out of position, then return the ball to the taker in the space he left.
pitch_frame: metres, origin at the centre spot, attack towards +x; corner at (52.5, -34)

movements.description: run-up from behind the goal line, strikes at 3.0 s
comes short towards the ball, brakes and receives facing it
reacts to the pass and closes A10 from the inside
support run infield along the goal line into the space D4 left

pass_sequence.rule: in play when kicked and clearly moving; no offside offence from a corner kick
A7 onside: x 51.04 vs second-last defender 51.6

defensive_response: D4 steps out from 10 m to close A10 (arrives 5.25 s); after the return pass he is 3-4 m from A7 and behind the play.
explanation: A short pass forces one defender to choose. When he steps out to the receiver, the space he protected opens for the taker's support run. Result: a small positional advantage (time and a free lane towards the box), not a goal chance.

rules_basis.law_17: ball placed in the corner area and stationary; opponents at least 9.15 m from the corner arc until the ball is in play; in play when kicked and clearly moves; the kicker must not touch it again before another player
rules_basis.law_11: no offside offence when receiving directly from a corner kick; afterwards offside position = nearer to the goal line than both the ball and the second-last opponent
rules_basis.source_status: from the IFAB Laws of the Game as known; the official text could not be downloaded in this session (network blocked), NEEDS REVIEW against the current edition

future_variations: B turns and drives if D does not step out
D2 steps out instead: near-post space opens
